雪花盛开之时会从某处现身，\n雪花凋零之时则会再度\n前往某处并隐藏自己的身影。:
It appears from somewhere when the snow flowers bloom,
and hides itself away again somewhere
when they wither.
生活在寒冷地方的宝可梦。\n4到5只组成一个团队，\n以出色的合作来追捕猎物。:
A Pokémon that lives in cold places.
Groups of four or five of them
hunt prey with excellent teamwork.
由受到特殊磁场影响的\n三合一磁怪进化而来。\n从3个组件中放出磁力。:
It evolved from a Magneton
that was affected by a special magnetic field.
It releases magnetic force from its three units.
不断伸出的舌头会卷住任何东西。\n一不留神靠近的话，\n就会被唾液弄得黏糊糊的。:
Its ever-extending tongue wraps around anything.
If you get too close without care,
you'll be left sticky with its saliva.
从手掌的洞里发射出小拳石。\n全身的护具连火山喷发都能经受住。:
It launches Geodude from the holes in its palms.
Its full-body armor can even withstand
a volcanic eruption.
伸出由植物的藤蔓\n长成的手臂缠住猎物。\n即便手臂被吃掉也毫不在意。:
It extends arms grown from plant vines
to ensnare its prey.
It doesn't mind even if its arms get eaten.
用2根尾巴的尖端按住对手，\n并放出超过2万伏特的电来进行攻击。:
It pins down its opponent with the tips of its two tails
and attacks by releasing over 20,000 volts of electricity.
从手臂前端发射出\n摄氏2000度的火球。\n以火山口作为自己的住所。:
It fires fireballs of 2,000 degrees Celsius
from the tips of its arms.
It makes its home in volcanic craters.
会给那些彼此认同对方且不做\n无端争斗的人们带去各种各样的恩惠。:
It bestows various blessings upon people
who respect one another and do not
fight without reason.
颚部的力量异常强大。\n擅长在高速飞行中咬碎\n与自己擦身而过的对手。:
The power of its jaws is extraordinary.
It excels at biting through opponents
it passes in high-speed flight.
在晴朗的日子里睡着的\n叶伊布会进行光合作用，\n制造出新鲜的空气。:
A Leafeon that sleeps on sunny days
performs photosynthesis,
producing fresh air.
通过降低体温让全身的体毛\n冻得像锐利的尖针一样，\n然后射出。:
It lowers its body temperature to freeze its fur
into sharp needles,
then fires them.
可以不发出振翅声而在空中飞行。\n用长长的尾巴捕捉猎物，\n再用牙齿一击刺中要害:
It can fly without flapping its wings.
It catches prey with its long tail,
then strikes a vital point with one bite.
从遥远的过去就存在的宝可梦，\n甚至在1万年前的冰层中也发现过它。:
A Pokémon that has existed since the distant past.
It has even been found in ice layers
from 10,000 years ago.
为了让它在异次元也能\n大显身手而修改了程序，\n但没有达到预期目标。:
Its program was modified so it could
play an active role in other dimensions,
but it did not achieve the intended goal.
修复数据与核心记忆产生共鸣后，\n为了保护重要的人进化成的形态。\n是超越了计算:
When its repaired data resonated with its core memories,
it evolved into this form to protect someone important.
It is a miracle of life that transcends calculation.
因为有着能敏锐感知对手想法的能力，\n所以可以率先攻击。:
Because it has the ability to keenly sense
its opponent's thoughts,
it can strike first.
从全身放出强大的磁力。\n操纵被称为小朝北鼻的3个部件。:
It releases powerful magnetic force from its whole body.
It manipulates three units called mini-noses.
据说，会把无处可去的魂魄\n吸入它那具有弹力的身体中，\n并带往另一个世界。:
It is said to inhale the souls of those with nowhere to go
into its elastic body
and carry them to another world.
据说它会吐出零下50度的\n气息冻结猎物，\n然后将其带到秘密的地方装饰起来。:
It is said to freeze its prey by breathing out
air at minus 50 degrees,
then carry them off to decorate a secret place.
作为驱动特殊马达的动力能源\n而被长期研究的宝可梦。:
A Pokémon that has been studied for a long time
as a power source for driving special motors.
据说，\n由克希的诞生给人类带来了\n令生活变得丰富多彩的智慧。:
It is said that
Uxie's birth brought humans
the wisdom that made their lives richer and more varied.
沉睡在湖底，\n但据说会灵魂出窍，\n在水面上飞来飞去。:
It sleeps at the bottom of a lake,
but it is said to leave its body
and fly about over the water's surface.
人们认为，\n由克希、艾姆利多和亚克诺姆\n是从同一个蛋里出生的宝可梦。:
It is believed that
Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf
were born from the same egg.
由于帝牙卢卡的诞生，\n时间才开始流动。\n是有着这样传说的宝可梦。:
It is a Pokémon of legend said to be
the reason time began to flow,
with the birth of Dialga.
据说居住在平行排列的空间狭缝中，\n是出现在神话中的宝可梦。:
It is said to live in the gaps between
dimensions aligned in parallel.
It is a Pokémon that appears in myths.
栖息在火山的洞穴里。\n用十字形的爪子钩住\n墙壁和洞顶爬来爬去。:
It dwells in volcanic caves.
It hooks its cross-shaped claws into
walls and cave ceilings to crawl around.
据说用特殊的冰山、岩石和熔岩\n制作出了形似自己的宝可梦。:
It is said to have made Pokémon resembling itself
out of special icebergs, rocks, and magma.
因为性格粗暴而被驱逐，\n一直待在毁坏的世界里，\n静静地看着原来的世界。:
Because of its violent nature, it was banished.
It dwells in the destroyed world,
quietly watching over the original one.
飞行的时候，\n会从薄纱一样的翅膀中发出闪光粒子。\n被称为新月的化身。:
When it flies,
it scatters glittering particles from its gossamer-like wings.
It is known as the incarnation of the new moon.
漂浮在温暖的海上。\n无论漂得多远，\n都一定会回到出生的地方。:
It drifts in warm seas.
No matter how far it drifts,
it always returns to the place where it was born.
如果使用与生俱来的神奇力量，\n就可以和任何宝可梦心意相通。:
By using the wondrous power it was born with,
it can communicate heart-to-heart with any Pokémon.
拥有诱使人们进入\n深度睡眠并做梦的能力。\n在朔月的夜晚活动。:
It has the ability to lure people
into a deep sleep and make them dream.
It is active on new moon nights.
当人们欣喜于严冬随季节更替终结，\n向上天奉献感谢之意时，此宝可梦\n就会现身，:
When people rejoice that the harsh winter has ended
with the changing of the seasons and give thanks to the heavens,
this Pokémon appears and makes the desolate land bloom with flowers.
如果获得了比克提尼所分享的\n无限生成的能量，\n就会全身充满力量。:
If it receives the infinite energy
that Victini shares,
its whole body fills with power.
用尾巴沐浴着阳光进行光合作用。\n如果没有精神，\n尾巴就会垂下来。:
It bathes its tail in sunlight to perform photosynthesis.
If it loses its spirit,
its tail droops.
如果身体变脏，\n就没法用叶子进行光合作用，\n所以它总是保持自身的清洁。:
If its body gets dirty,
it can't perform photosynthesis with its leaves,
so it always keeps itself clean.
仅仅是盯着，\n就能令对手动弹不得。\n能让太阳能量在体内增强。:
Merely glaring at an opponent
can leave it unable to move.
It can intensify solar energy within its body.
非常喜欢吃烤过的树果，\n但因为太兴奋而时常烤得焦黑。:
It loves to eat roasted Berries,
but it gets so excited that it often burns them to a crisp.
如果体内的火焰燃起，\n动作就会变得非常敏捷。\n危机时刻会喷出烟雾。:
When the flame inside its body ignites,
its movements become extremely agile.
In a crisis, it spews out smoke.
一直蓄着火焰的胡须。\n身怀兼具力量与速度的格斗招式。:
Its beard is always alight with flames.
It has fighting moves that combine power and speed.
用腹部的扇贝贝战斗。\n抵挡住攻击后，\n会立马切斩反击。:
It battles using the scallop on its belly.
After blocking an attack,
it immediately slashes back with a counterattack.
经过严格的修炼后，\n每只双刃丸都会学会\n不同套路的扇贝贝刀法。:
After rigorous training,
each Dewott learns
a different style of scallop-blade technique.
用收在铠甲里的剑攻击敌人，\n一挥就能将对手打倒。\n瞪一眼就能让敌人不敢出声。:
It attacks enemies with the swords kept inside its armor,
felling an opponent with a single swing.
One glare is enough to silence an enemy.
戒备心很强，\n必定有1只在负责放哨，\n但不会注意到后方来的敌人。:
It is very wary,
and there is always one of them standing guard,
but it doesn't notice enemies coming from behind.
射出藏在颊囊里的树果种子进行攻击。\n一旦发现敌人，\n尾巴会竖起来。:
It attacks by shooting Berry seeds stored in its cheek pouches.
The moment it spots an enemy,
its tail stands on end.
虽说是勇猛的宝可梦，\n但也有很聪明的一面，\n会在认清对手的实力后避开战斗。:
Though it is a valiant Pokémon,
it also has a clever side:
it sizes up its opponent's strength and avoids fights.
像斗篷一样覆盖在身上的\n黑色体毛非常坚硬。\n可以让它减少受到的伤害。:
The black fur covering its body like a cloak
is very tough.
It reduces the damage it takes.
如果被它长长的体毛包裹着，\n就会变得温暖又舒适，即使是在冬天\n的山上也能淡定:
Wrapped in its long fur, you'll be warm and comfortable
enough to calmly spend a night on a mountain
even in winter.
出于好玩偷盗人的物品。\n被偷的人也因其逗人喜爱的\n动作而不自觉地原谅它。:
It steals people's belongings for fun.
Those who are robbed forgive it before they know it,
charmed by its adorable antics.
隐藏气息悄悄接近。\n在对手发觉前，\n从背后偷偷靠近并了结它。:
It hides its presence and creeps up quietly.
Before the opponent notices,
it sneaks up from behind and finishes it off.
擅长寻找树果，\n有着到处搜集树果分给伙伴的善心。:
It excels at finding Berries
and is kind enough to gather them everywhere
to share with its companions.
性格粗暴，\n会挥动着带有尖刺的尾巴战斗。\n头上的叶子非常苦。:
It has a rough nature
and battles by swinging its spiky tail.
The leaf on its head is extremely bitter.
生活在火山的洞穴里。\n头上的那丛毛发熊熊燃烧着，\n温度高达300度。:
It lives in volcanic caves.
The tuft of fur on its head blazes furiously,
reaching temperatures of 300 degrees.
兴奋的时候，从头和尾巴飞扬起\n火花，身体变热。\n不知为何很喜欢吃甜的东西。:
When excited, sparks fly from its head and tail,
and its body heats up.
For some reason, it loves sweet food.
头上的毛发丛里储藏的水充满了营养。\n如果给植物浇了，\n就会茁壮成长。:
The water stored in the tuft of fur on its head
is full of nutrients.
If it waters a plant with it, the plant will grow vigorously.
喜欢水很干净的地方。\n一旦头上储藏的水减少，\n就会用尾巴吸水来补充。:
It likes places with clean water.
When the water stored on its head runs low,
it replenishes it by drawing water in with its tail.
会吃掉人和宝可梦做的梦。\n如果吃了快乐的梦，\n就会吐出粉红色的烟雾来。:
It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon.
If it eats a happy dream,
it exhales pink smoke.
从额头冒出的梦的烟雾，\n会根据所吃梦的内容，\n变成各种各样的颜色。:
The dream mist that leaks from its forehead
changes into various colors
depending on the dreams it has eaten.
生活在街道上的宝可梦。\n因为不怎么怕人，\n所以会大量聚集在公园或广场。:
A Pokémon that lives in towns.
Because it doesn't fear people much,
it gathers in large numbers in parks and plazas.
无论身在世界的哪个角落，\n都会知道自己的巢在哪里，\n所以也不会和训练家走散。:
No matter where in the world it is,
it always knows where its nest is,
so it never gets separated from its Trainer.
雄性的头上有冠羽。\n绝对不会亲近训练家以外的人。:
Males have a crest of feathers on their heads.
They will never warm up to anyone
other than their Trainer.
如果放电，鬃毛就会发光。\n通过鬃毛闪耀的次数\n和节奏与伙伴对话。:
When it discharges electricity, its mane glows.
It talks with its companions through the number of times
its mane flashes and its rhythm.
有着闪电般的瞬间爆发力。\n如果雷电斑马以全速奔跑，\n就会雷声轰鸣。:
It has lightning-like instantaneous explosive power.
When a Zebstrika runs at full speed,
thunder rumbles.
100年前的大地震时，\n从地裂中被发现。\n体内拥有能量核心。:
It was discovered in a fissure in the ground
during a great earthquake 100 years ago.
It has an energy core inside its body.
如果精神好，核心就会凸出。\n无需改变身体的朝向，\n就能前后左右迅速移动。:
When it's in good spirits, its core protrudes.
Without changing the direction it faces,
it can move quickly in all directions.
用体内的核心将能量压缩后\n再将其射出进行攻击，\n威力足以吹飞山岳。:
It compresses energy with its core
and fires it to attack,
with enough power to blow away a mountain.
据说如果按住滚滚蝙蝠的鼻子，\n接触到它鼻子的地方留下\n心形痕迹的话，就会有好:
It is said that if you press a Woobat's nose
and a heart-shaped mark is left
where you touched it, good things will happen.
如果被雄性向雌性求爱时\n发出的超音波照到，\n心情就会变得非常快乐。:
If you are bathed in the ultrasonic waves
a male emits when courting a female,
your mood becomes very cheerful.
将双掌上的爪子并拢，\n并让身体高速旋转的话，\n就会以迅猛的速度在地里前进。:
It presses the claws on its palms together
and spins its body at high speed,
moving through the ground with tremendous speed.
进化成钢的钻头拥有\n穿透铁板的破坏力。\n在隧道工程里非常活跃。:
The drill that evolved into steel has
the destructive power to pierce iron plates.
It is very active in tunnel construction.
用耳朵上的触角碰到对方的话，\n就能通过心跳声了解\n对方的身体状况和情绪。:
If its feelers touch someone,
it can learn that person's physical condition
and emotions from their heartbeat.
经常拿着方材走，\n帮忙做土木工程。\n长大后会换大的方材拿。:
It always carries a squared timber
and helps with construction work.
When it grows up, it carries a bigger one.
身体经过锻炼充满了肌肉，\n即使是职业摔角手一拥而上进行攻击，\n也是纹丝不动。:
Its body is honed and packed with muscle,
so it won't budge even if professional wrestlers
attack it all at once.
制作混凝土的技术，\n被认为是2000年前\n从修建老匠那儿学来的。:
The technique for making concrete
is said to have been learned
from Conkeldurr 2,000 years ago.
振动脸颊发出人类无法听见的音波。\n通过音波的节奏对话。:
It vibrates its cheeks to emit sound waves
that humans cannot hear.
It talks using the rhythm of these sound waves.
生活在水中和陆地。\n使用黏糊糊的长舌头封锁对手的行动。:
It lives in water and on land.
It uses its slimy long tongue
to lock down its opponent's movements.
从头上的瘤里喷出令神经麻痹的液体。\n通过震动折磨对手。:
It sprays a liquid that paralyzes the nerves
from the lumps on its head.
It torments its opponent with vibrations.
如果遇到比自己大的对手，\n就忍不住极度想要投摔。\n变强后就会替换带子。:
When it faces an opponent bigger than itself,
it can't help but desperately want to throw them.
When it grows stronger, it changes its belt.
系紧带子后会很振奋，\n拳击的破坏力得到提升。\n如果打扰它修行就会发怒。:
It gets fired up when it tightens its belt,
raising the destructive power of its punches.
It gets angry if you disturb its training.
因为会用叶子做衣服，\n所以作为吉祥物而受到\n时尚设计师的喜爱。:
Because it makes clothes out of leaves,
it is loved by fashion designers as a mascot.
用叶子包裹着身体抵御寒冷。\n一边吃着手边的落叶，\n一边在森林里移动。:
It wraps its body in leaves to ward off the cold.
It moves through the forest
while eating fallen leaves.
利用落叶发酵的热量温暖蛋。\n用叶子给虫宝包制作襁褓。:
It uses the heat from fermenting fallen leaves to warm its eggs.
It makes swaddling clothes
for Sewaddle out of leaves.
会咬住对手施以剧毒。\n就连它的天敌大型鸟宝可梦\n也会身体麻痹，动弹不得。:
It bites its opponent and injects a powerful venom.
Even its natural enemies, large bird Pokémon,
are left paralyzed and unable to move.
平时一动不动，\n可一旦受袭就会高速旋转奔跑，\n并用撞击来反击。:
It is normally motionless,
but once attacked, it spins at high speed to run away
and counters with a tackle.
以敏捷的动作穷追敌人，\n用头上的角进行攻击。\n在敌人毙命前绝不罢手。:
It chases down its enemies with agile movements
and attacks with the horn on its head.
It never lets up until the enemy is dead.
一旦被袭击就会从体内喷出棉花。\n趁着敌人把棉花错认为\n木棉球时逃之夭夭。:
Once attacked, it spews cotton from its body.
It escapes while the enemy mistakes the cotton
for a Cottonee.
像风一样无孔不入，\n无论多细小的缝隙都能穿过。\n会留下白色的毛球。:
Like the wind, it can slip through any gap,
no matter how small.
It leaves behind white balls of fluff.
因为非常喜欢水分和营养充足的土壤，\n所以百合根娃娃居住的土地，\n作物生长旺盛:
Because it loves soil rich in water and nutrients,
crops grow vigorously on the land
where Petilil dwells.
即便是资深训练家，\n要让它开出美丽的花也很难。\n是很受名流喜爱的宝可梦。:
Even for veteran Trainers,
making it bloom beautiful flowers is difficult.
It is a Pokémon loved by celebrities.
在沙漠的沙子里生活。\n被太阳烘得暖暖的沙子\n会防止体温降低。:
It lives in the sand of the desert.
The sand warmed by the sun
keeps its body temperature from dropping.
覆盖着眼球的特殊膜\n可以感知物体的热度，\n因此即便在黑暗中也能看见周围。:
The special membrane covering its eyeballs
can sense the heat of objects,
so it can see its surroundings even in the dark.
遇见它的猎物无处可逃。\n拥有可以咬烂汽车车身的强力颚部。:
Prey that meet it have nowhere to run.
It has powerful jaws that can crush a car's body.
在它睡觉的时候，\n无论是推是拉，它都不会倒下。\n因为象征着吉利而大受欢迎。:
While it sleeps, it won't fall over
no matter how much you push or pull it.
Because it symbolizes good fortune, it is very popular.
通过在体内燃起1400度的火焰，\n可以制造出足以赤手空拳\n破坏翻斗车的力量。:
By burning a flame of 1,400 degrees inside its body,
it can produce enough power to destroy
a dump truck with its bare hands.
生活在干燥的土地上。\n如果身体有节奏地动起来，\n就会奏出沙铃那样的声音。:
It lives on dry land.
When it moves its body rhythmically,
it makes a sound like a maraca.
如果有大小合适的石头，\n就会从嘴里分泌液体，\n开出一个可以进入的洞。:
If it finds a stone of the right size,
it secretes a liquid from its mouth
and hollows out a hole it can enter.
为了争夺领地，\n岩殿居蟹之间会展开激烈的战斗。\n岩石被破坏的一方就算输。:
Crustle fight each other fiercely over territory.
The one whose rock is broken loses.
以结实的头盖骨自豪。\n会冷不防给对方一记头锤，\n但自己也会因为重量而站立不稳:
It is proud of its sturdy skull.
It headbutts opponents without warning,
but its own weight makes it stagger.
按头上冠的大小来决定团队领袖。\n用脚踢攻击破坏混凝土块。:
The leader of the group is decided
by the size of its crest.
It kicks to attack, breaking concrete blocks.
古代都市的守护神。\n过去一直以相同路线巡视，\n警戒着入侵者。:
A guardian deity of an ancient city.
It has long patrolled the same route,
on guard against intruders.
拿着的面具是哭哭面具\n还是人类时的脸。\n偶尔会注视着面具哭泣。:
The mask it carries was its face when it was human.
It occasionally gazes at the mask and cries.
会把将它误认为是真正的棺材\n而接近的盗墓贼关在自己体内。:
It traps grave robbers who mistake it for a real coffin
and approach, sealing them inside its body.
由古代的化石复活而来。\n能潜水到1000米的深度。:
It was revived from an ancient fossil.
It can dive to a depth of 1,000 meters.
用发达的前肢将对手揍到昏厥，\n然后连壳带骨整个嚼碎。:
It knocks its opponent unconscious with its well-developed forelimbs,
then chews it up whole,
shell and bones included.
据说是鸟宝可梦的祖先。\n不能飞行，\n好像会在枝条间跳来跳去生活。:
It is said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon.
It cannot fly
and seems to live by hopping between branches.
比起飞行，更擅长奔跑。\n以时速40公里飞奔的势头\n朝着天空展翅飞翔。:
It is better at running than flying.
It runs at 40 kilometers per hour to build up speed,
then spreads its wings and soars into the sky.
喜欢不卫生的地方。\n如果吸入它像打嗝那样吐出的瓦斯，\n会整整1个星期卧病不起:
It likes unsanitary places.
If you inhale the gas it belches out,
you'll be bedridden for a whole week.
不断吸入垃圾，\n在体内产生出新种类的毒瓦斯和毒液。:
It keeps inhaling garbage,
producing new kinds of poisonous gas and venom inside its body.
会幻化成人类或其他宝可梦。\n通过隐藏自己的本来面貌\n来保护自己不受危险侵害。:
It can disguise itself as a human or another Pokémon.
It protects itself from danger
by hiding its true form.
拥有一下子迷惑许多人的力量。\n展现出虚幻的景色来保护自己的住所。:
It has the power to bewilder many people at once.
It protects its home by showing illusory scenery.
是喜爱干净的宝可梦。\n总是把尾巴当做扫帚，\n来清扫住所的灰尘。:
It is a Pokémon that loves cleanliness.
It always uses its tail like a broom
to sweep the dust from its home.
奇诺栗鼠的身上覆盖着特别的油脂，\n可以卸掉拳击等来自对手的攻击。:
Cinccino's body is covered in special oils
that can deflect attacks like punches
from opponents.
目不转睛地观察宝可梦和训练家。\n好像正盯着某样只有\n哥德宝宝才能看见的东西。:
It gazes intently at Pokémon and Trainers.
It seems to be staring at something
only Gothita can see.
世间流传着很多这样的说法，\n它们会在星光闪烁的夜晚，\n操纵睡着的孩子，耍着玩:
There are many tales that,
on starry nights, they manipulate sleeping children
and play with them.
拥有根据星星的分布和动向\n来预知未来的能力。\n训练家的寿命也能看见。:
It has the ability to foresee the future
based on the positions and movements of the stars.
It can even see a Trainer's lifespan.
放出精神力量击退来袭的敌人。\n用心灵感应和伙伴对话。:
It releases psychic power to repel attacking enemies.
It talks with its companions through telepathy.
因为有着一分为二的大脑，\n所以有时会突然采取不同的行动。:
Because its brain is split in two,
it sometimes suddenly takes different actions.
如果人造细胞卵互相握住手，\n大脑就像通过网络连接一样，\n精神力量得以增强。:
When Reuniclus hold hands with each other,
their brains link up like a network,
and their psychic power grows stronger.
比起飞行，更擅长游泳。\n会潜入水中，\n开心地吃非常喜欢的水青苔。:
It is better at swimming than flying.
It dives into the water
and happily eats the water moss it loves.
随着黎明的来临，\n舞天鹅们开始跳舞。\n在正中间跳的是群体的首领。:
As dawn breaks,
the Swanna begin to dance.
The one dancing in the very center is the leader of the flock.
冰柱沐浴了朝阳的能量之后，\n变成了宝可梦。\n会把身体埋在雪里睡觉。:
An icicle became a Pokémon
after being bathed in the energy of the morning sun.
It sleeps with its body buried in snow.
栖息在雪山的宝可梦。\n在遥远过去的冰河时期\n迁移到了南方的土地。:
A Pokémon that dwells on snowy mountains.
In an ice age of the distant past,
it migrated to southern lands.
喝入大量水后，\n在体内变成雪云。\n如果生气，就会卷起猛烈的暴风雪。:
It drinks large amounts of water,
turning it into snow clouds inside its body.
If it gets angry, it whips up a violent blizzard.
将脸颊的电力袋制造出的\n电储藏在膜的内侧，\n一边滑翔一边放电。:
It stores the electricity made in the electric sacs on its cheeks
inside its membranes,
then glides while discharging it.
通过穿上小嘴蜗的壳\n进化而成的宝可梦。\n钢铁的铠甲保护着它的全身。:
A Pokémon that evolved by putting on Shelmet's shell.
Its steel armor protects its entire body.
以精灵球一样的花纹引诱宝可梦过来，\n然后向其喷出有毒的孢子。:
It lures Pokémon close with markings
that look like a Poké Ball,
then sprays them with poisonous spores.
摇晃着双臂酷似精灵球的菌伞，\n跳起引诱猎物的舞蹈。:
It wiggles its arms and the mushroom cap
that resembles a Poké Ball,
dancing to lure in prey.
用薄纱般的手脚缠绕对手，\n使其麻痹后，\n就会拖到8000米的深海捕杀。:
It wraps its gossamer-thin limbs around its opponent,
and once the opponent is paralyzed,
it drags them 8,000 meters underwater to kill them.
误入胖嘟嘟住所的船会沉没，\n船员们的生命也会被吸走。:
Ships that stray into a Jellicent's territory sink,
and the lives of the crew are drained away.
会用鱼鳍温柔地抱住受伤\n的或是虚弱的宝可梦，\n然后用特殊的粘膜治疗。:
It gently embraces injured or weakened Pokémon with its fins
and heals them with a special mucous membrane.
因为自己不能制造电，\n所以会附在其它大型宝可梦\n身上吸取静电。:
Because it can't make its own electricity,
it latches onto other large Pokémon
and absorbs their static electricity.
被敌人袭击的话，\n会吐出大量带电的丝，\n制作成电的屏障。:
When attacked by an enemy,
it spits out large amounts of electrified thread
to create a barrier of electricity.
刺入洞顶，\n吸取岩石中的铁质。\n当危险逼近，就会射出尖刺。:
It pierces cave ceilings
and absorbs the iron in the rock.
When danger approaches, it fires its spikes.
贴在洞顶上，\n朝下方经过的猎物射出铁刺进行袭击。:
It clings to the ceiling
and fires iron spikes at prey passing below to attack them.
2个身体的组合是定好了的。\n和别的身体不会咬合会分离。:
The pairing of its two bodies is fixed.
It will separate and won't mesh with any other body.
身体分为大齿轮和小齿轮。\n如果攻击时发射出去的\n小齿轮回不来的话，就会死去。:
Its body is divided into a big gear and a small gear.
If the small gear it fires when attacking
doesn't come back, it will die.
红色核心担当着能量罐的角色。\n填充好的能量会从尖刺射向周围。:
The red core serves as an energy tank.
The charged energy is fired
from its spikes at its surroundings.
1条的电力虽小，\n但是许多麻麻小鱼聚在一起，\n其威力可以比得上雷电。:
One alone has little electric power,
but when many Tynamo gather together,
their power can rival lightning.
是食欲旺盛的宝可梦。\n一旦发现猎物就会发动袭击，\n将对方用电麻痹后再吃掉。:
It is a Pokémon with a voracious appetite.
The moment it spots prey, it attacks,
paralyzes them with electricity, and eats them.
用手臂的力量从海里爬出，\n袭击水边的猎物。\n在一瞬间将对方拖入海中。:
It crawls out of the sea using the strength of its arms
and attacks prey at the water's edge,
dragging them into the sea in an instant.
据说它是来自于传闻50年前\n有UFO坠落的沙漠里。:
It is said to have come from a desert
where a UFO was rumored to have crashed 50 years ago.
用精神力量操纵对手的大脑，\n并改写其大脑里的记忆影像。:
It uses psychic power to manipulate its opponent's brain
and rewrite the memories and images within it.
假装点亮烛光，\n指引道路，\n实际上是在吸取对方的生命力。:
It pretends to light the way with its flame,
but in reality it is draining the life force of its victims.
吸取灵魂来点亮灯火。\n为了等待人类死去，\n而在医院里彷徨游荡。:
It absorbs souls to light its flame.
It wanders through hospitals,
waiting for humans to die.
被怪异的火焰燃烧过的灵魂无处可去，\n只能永远游荡在这个世界上。:
Souls burned by its strange flames have nowhere to go
and must wander this world forever.
用牙齿在树木上留下伤痕，\n作为领地的标记。\n牙齿即使折断也会马上长出来。:
It leaves gashes in trees with its tusks to mark its territory.

牙齿不会再次生长，\n因此战斗结束后就会使用\n河滩的岩石仔细地磨牙。:
Its tusks won't grow back,
so after battles it carefully sharpens them

有着即使切斩工字钢\n也不会伤刃的坚固牙齿。\n全身被坚硬的铠甲覆盖着。:
It has sturdy tusks that won't dull
even when cutting steel beams.
Its entire body is covered in hard armor.
鼻涕是健康的晴雨表。\n身体状况好，粘性就变强，\n冰的招式威力也会增强。:
Its runny nose is a barometer of its health.

让吐出的气息冻结，\n制造冰牙和冰爪进行战斗。\n生活在北方的寒冷土地上。:
It freezes its breath

It lives in cold lands of the north.
使用冰的结晶所形成的锁绑住猎物，\n使其冻结到零下100度。:
It binds its prey with chains formed from ice crystals,

如果与盖盖虫一起沐浴在电能下，\n就会进化。\n其原因尚且不明。:
If it is bathed in electric energy together with a Karrablast,

身体干燥的话就会变弱。\n身上卷着一层又一层的薄膜，\n用来防止干燥。:
It weakens if its body dries out.
It wraps layer upon layer of membrane around itself

会埋进海边的泥里等待猎物。\n猎物一旦碰到，\n就会放出电来使其麻痹。:
It buries itself in the mud by the sea and waits for prey.

使出行云流水般的连续攻击压倒敌人。\n用锋利的爪子将敌人撕裂。:
It overwhelms its enemies with a flowing series of attacks.
It tears enemies apart with its sharp claws.
双臂上的体毛使用得像鞭子一样熟练。\n一旦开始连续攻击，\n谁也无法阻止。:
It uses the fur on its arms as skillfully as whips.

用翅膀接收阳光，\n温暖身体。\n如果体温下降就会变得无法动弹。:

根据古代的科学力量\n由黏土制成的宝可梦。\n能持续活动数千年。:
A Pokémon made of clay

以音速在天空飞行。\n如果解开胸口的封印，\n能量就会失控。:
It flies through the sky at the speed of sound.

即使自己受伤也毫不在意，\n整个群体一起将全身的刀\n刺入对手进行攻击。:
Even if it gets hurt itself, it doesn't care.

率领一大群驹刀小兵，\n成群地穷追猎物。\n劈斩司令会给予致命一击。:
It leads a large pack of Pawniard,
pursuing prey in a swarm.

即使使出猛烈的头锤，\n蓬松的体毛也会将伤害都吸收掉。:
Even if it takes a fierce headbutt,

面对强劲的对手也\n会不由分说地挑起战斗。\n通过反复战斗变得更强。:
It picks fights with even powerful opponents

It grows stronger through repeated battles.
为了伙伴的话，\n无论受多重的伤都不会放弃战斗，\n是勇敢的天空战士。:
For the sake of its companions,

It is a brave warrior of the skies.
翅膀很小，\n还不能飞。\n用秃鹰娜收集来的骸骨保护着臀部。:
Its wings are small,

从空中观察地面情况，\n袭击弱小的猎物。\n有用骨头做装饰的习性。:
It observes the ground from the sky

把从尾部吸入的空气变成火焰，\n像舌头一样使用，\n熔化铁蚁后吃掉。:

身上裹着钢铁的铠甲。\n以群体之力防御并反击\n天敌熔蚁兽的攻击。:

如果吃光了领地内的食物，\n就会向其他土地移动。\n2个头之间关系恶劣。:

对活动物体发生反应并展开袭击，\n用3个头吃光一切的恐怖宝可梦。:
A terrifying Pokémon that reacts to moving objects

栖息在火山脚下。\n从5只角喷出火焰，\n击退来袭的敌人。:
It dwells at the foot of volcanoes.
It sprays flames from its five horns

据说，\n当地面因火山灰而变得一片漆黑时，\n火神蛾的火焰就会代替太阳的作用。:
It is said that
when the ground turns pitch-black from volcanic ash,
Volcarona's flames act in place of the sun.
拥有钢铁的心灵和身体。\n当人类伤害到宝可梦时，\n就会和伙伴一起惩戒人类。:
It has a body and heart of steel.
When humans harm Pokémon,
it punishes them together with its companions.
是传说中所描述的宝可梦。\n为了保护宝可梦，\n会用引以为豪的力量破坏城堡。:
A Pokémon spoken of in legends.
To protect Pokémon,
it destroys castles with the strength it takes pride in.
传说中，\n以敏捷的身手戏弄对手，\n保护宝可梦。:
Legend says it protects Pokémon
by outwitting opponents with its nimble movements.
从龙卷云的尾部喷出的能量\n会引起猛烈的暴风雨。\n有着吹飞民宅的力量。:
The energy spewed from Tornadus's tail
causes violent storms.
It has the power to blow houses away.
一边在天空飞来飞去，\n一边到处打雷引发山火，\n因此被人嫌弃。:
It flies about the sky,
striking lightning everywhere and causing wildfires,

莱希拉姆的尾部燃烧的话，\n就会产生热能令大气运动，\n让世界的天气发生变化。:
When Reshiram's tail flares,
it produces heat that moves the atmosphere,
changing the world's weather.
用尾巴制造出电。\n把全身隐藏在雷云里，\n在合众地区的空中飞行。:
It produces electricity with its tail.
It hides its whole body in thunderclouds

吸收风和雷后变成能量，\n会给予土壤营养，\n令大地丰饶。:
It absorbs wind and lightning to turn them into energy,
which nourishes the soil

在体内制造出强力的冰冻能量，\n但身体因为泄漏的冷气而冻住了。:
It produces powerful freezing energy inside its body,
but its body is frozen by the cold air that leaks out.
据说当它挺过了艰难的战斗，\n额头上的角就能得到锻炼，\n从而激发出自己真正的力:
It is said that when it endures a tough battle,
the horn on its forehead is tempered,
and its true power is awakened.
用特殊的发声法唱出的旋律\n可以自由地操纵听者的情绪。:
The melody it sings using a special vocal technique
can freely manipulate the emotions of those who hear it.
3亿年前就存在的宝可梦。\n被等离子队改造，\n背上安装了炮台。:
A Pokémon that has existed for 300 million years.
It was modified by Team Plasma,
which installed a cannon on its back.
头和背部用坚硬的木壳覆盖着，\n所以即使被卡车撞到也安然无恙。:
Its head and back are covered in a hard wooden shell,
so it is unharmed even if hit by a truck.
一记撞击就能撞飞拖车。\n由于它的痛觉很迟钝，\n因此撞得很猛也没问题。:
A single tackle can send a trailer flying.
Because its sense of pain is dull,
it's fine even when it charges hard.
性格温和，不爱争斗，\n但只要到了紧要关头，\n就会用带刺的拳头击溃对手。:
It has a gentle nature and doesn't like to fight,
but when the situation demands it,
it crushes its opponent with its thorny fists.
随身带着小树枝，\n嘎吱嘎吱地当零食吃。\n从耳朵里喷出热气威吓对手。:
It always carries a small twig
and munches on it as a snack.
It blows hot air from its ears to intimidate opponents.
将树枝从尾巴上拔出时，\n会因为摩擦而起火。\n挥动树枝的火焰向伙伴传递信号。:
When it pulls the twig from its tail,
friction sets it on fire.
It swings the twig's flames to signal its companions.
用超能力操纵摄氏\n3000度的火焰旋涡。\n用旋涡包住敌人后烧得精光。:
It uses psychic powers to control
a 3,000-degree vortex of flames.
It wraps enemies in the vortex and burns them to nothing.
用细腻的泡泡包住身体，\n保护皮肤。装得无忧无虑的，\n实则很精明地窥视着四周。:
It wraps its body in delicate bubbles to protect its skin.
It acts carefree,
but in truth it shrewdly watches its surroundings.
灵巧的身体不输给任何人。\n只需1分钟就能登上\n超过600米高的塔顶。:
Its nimble body is second to none.
It can climb to the top of a tower
over 600 meters high in just one minute.
像忍者般神出鬼没。\n以敏捷的动作玩弄对手，\n再用水之手里剑将对方劈开。:
It appears and disappears like a ninja.
It toys with opponents with agile movements,
then slices them with water shuriken.
拥有铁锹一样的耳朵。\n因挖洞而锻炼过的耳朵威力\n大得可以切断粗粗的树根。:
It has ears like shovels.
Its ears, tempered by digging holes, are powerful enough
to sever thick tree roots.
耳朵的力量可以媲美铲车，\n连坚硬的岩盘也能被它粉碎。\n挖洞结束后，就会悠哉地:
Its ears have power rivaling a power shovel,
able to crush even solid bedrock.
After it finishes digging, it lives a carefree life.
婉转的叫声很美，\n但对于进入领地的对手毫不留情，\n非常粗暴。:
Its beautiful song is lovely,
but it is merciless and very rough

腹部火袋的火力越强，\n飞得越快。\n但是点着火需要花些时间。:
The stronger the fire in its belly pouch,
the faster it flies.
However, it takes a while to ignite the fire.
袭击猎物的时候，\n时速达到500公里。\n用猛烈的脚踢了结对手。:
When it attacks prey,
it reaches a speed of 500 kilometers per hour.
It finishes off its opponent with a fierce kick.
为了变强而开始离开群体，\n独自生活。\n血气旺盛，很冲动。:
To grow stronger, it leaves its group
and lives alone.
It is hot-blooded and impulsive.
在战斗时，\n雄性的鬃毛会提升到摄氏2000度。\n光是靠近都会造成重度灼伤。:
In battle, the male's mane rises
to 2,000 degrees Celsius.
Merely approaching it causes severe burns.
如果有水和阳光，\n就能用背上的叶子制造能量，\n所以即使不吃食物也没事。:
If it has water and sunlight,

在山岳地带生活。\n互相撞角比力气的胜利者\n就是群体的首领。:

通过理毛然后将积在腹中的落毛燃烧，\n喷出火焰。根据吐毛的方式不同，\n火焰也会:
